chapter: Working with Duke and final reflections
title: Chairman of the Board of Duke's band
summary: Whaley explains how he became Duke's 'Chairman of the Board' by handling Duke's mail and sending Christmas money to relatives.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Well, that's beautiful Tom, you've really given me some -- I want to get into some depth with you and Duke, how close you were with Duke? How did you get along so well, what did he call you -- the Chairman of the Board.
How did you arrive at that?
Well, see, when I first went into the band, I used to take all of his mail and read it and if he had anything important, I used to tell him.
That this was important -- you know, like on Christmas, he'd give me so much money and he'd give me the names of all his relatives, and I'd send them that $100, see.
Yeah, that's pretty close. You were the guy who did that.
